ayahs.text: Ha. Mim.
ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ

ayahs.text: CONSIDER this divine writ, clear in itself and clearly showing the truth!
ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ

ayahs.text: Behold, from on high have We bestowed it on a blessed night: for, verily, We have always been warning [man].
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍۢ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ

ayahs.text: On that [night] was made clear, in wisdom, the distinction between all things [good and evil]
ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ

ayahs.text: at a behest from Ourselves: for, verily, We have always been sending [Our messages of guidance]
ayahs.arabic: أَمْرًۭا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ

ayahs.text: in pur­suance of thy Sustainer’s grace [unto man]. Verily, He alone is all-hearing, all-knowing,
ayahs.arabic: رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

ayahs.text: the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them - if you could but grasp it with inner certainty!
ayahs.arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

ayahs.text: There is no deity save Him: He grants life and deals death: He is your Sustainer as well as the Sustainer of your forebears of old.
ayahs.arabic: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

ayahs.text: Nay, but they [who lack inner certainty] are but Dying with their doubts.
ayahs.arabic: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ يَلْعَبُونَ

ayahs.text: WAIT, THEN, for the Day when the skies shall bring forth a pall of smoke which will make obvious [the approach of the Last Hour],
ayahs.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

ayahs.text: enveloping all mankind, [and causing the sinners to exclaim:] “Grievous is this suffering!
ayahs.arabic: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ

ayahs.text: O our Sustainer, relieve us of suffering, for, verily, we [now] believe [in Thee]!”
ayahs.arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ

ayahs.text: [But] how shall this remembrance avail them [at the Last Hour], seeing that an apostle had pre­viously come unto them, clearly expounding the truth,
ayahs.arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

ayahs.text: whereupon they turned their backs on him and said, “Taught [by others] is he, a madman”?
ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌۭ مَّجْنُونٌ

ayahs.text: [Still,] behold, We shall postpone this suffer­ing for a little while, although you are bound to revert [to your evil ways: but]
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ

ayahs.text: on the Day when We shall seize [all sinners] with a most mighty onslaught, We shall, verily, inflict Our retribution [on you as well]!
ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ

ayahs.text: AND, INDEED, [long] before their time did We try Pharaoh’s people [in the same way]: for there came unto them a noble apostle, [who said:]
ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ كَرِيمٌ

ayahs.text: “Give in unto me, O God’s bondmen! Verily, I am an apostle [sent] unto you, worthy of trust!
ayahs.arabic: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ

ayahs.text: “And exalt not yourselves against God: for, verily, I come unto you with a manifest authority [from Him];
ayahs.arabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

ayahs.text: and, behold, it is with my Sustainer - and your Sustainer - that I seek refuge against all your endeavours to revile me.
ayahs.arabic: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ

ayahs.text: And if you do not believe me, [at least] stand away from me!”
ayahs.arabic: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ

ayahs.text: But then, [when they beset him with their enmity,] he called out to his Sustainer, “These are [indeed] people lost in sin!”
ayahs.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ مُّجْرِمُونَ

ayahs.text: And [God said]: “Go thou forth with My servants by night, for you will surely be pursued;
ayahs.arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

ayahs.text: and leave the sea becalmed [between thee and Pharaoh’s men]: for, verily, they are a host destined to be drowned!”
ayahs.arabic: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّغْرَقُونَ

ayahs.text: [And so they perished: and] how many gardens did they leave behind, and water-runnels,
ayahs.arabic: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ

ayahs.text: and fields of grain, and noble dwellings,
ayahs.arabic: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ

ayahs.text: and [all that] life of ease in which they used to delight!
ayahs.arabic: وَنَعْمَةٍۢ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ

ayahs.text: Thus it was. And [then] We made another people heirs [to what they had left],
ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ

ayahs.text: and neither sky nor earth shed tears over them, nor were they allowed a respite.
ayahs.arabic: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ

ayahs.text: And, indeed, We delivered the children of Israel from the shameful suffering
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ

ayahs.text: [inflicted on them] by Pharaoh, seeing that he was truly outstand­ing among those who waste their own selves;
ayahs.arabic: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ

ayahs.text: and indeed, We chose them knowingly above all other people,
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

ayahs.text: and gave them such signs [of Our grace] as would clearly presage a test.
ayahs.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٌۭا۟ مُّبِينٌ

ayahs.text: [Now,] behold, these [people] say indeed:
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ

ayahs.text: “That [which is ahead of us] is but our first [and only] death, and we shall not be raised to life again.
ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

ayahs.text: So then, bring forth our forefathers [as witnesses], if what you claim is true!”
ayahs.arabic: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ

ayahs.text: Are they, then, better than the people of Tubba and those before them, whom We destroyed because they were truly lost in [the same] sin?
ayahs.arabic: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ

ayahs.text: For [thus it is:] We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in mere idle play:
ayahs.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ

ayahs.text: none of this have We created without [an inner] truth: but most of them under­stand it not.
ayahs.arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

ayahs.text: VERILY, the Day of Distinction [between the true and the false] is the term appointed for all of them:
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

ayahs.text: the Day when no friend shall be of the least avail to his friend, and when none shall be succoured
ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًۭى شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

ayahs.text: save those upon whom God will have bestowed His grace and mercy: for, verily, He alone is almighty, a dispenser of grace.
ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

ayahs.text: Verily, [in the life to come] the tree of deadly fruit
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

ayahs.text: will be the food of the sinful:
ayahs.arabic: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ

ayahs.text: like molten lead will it boil in the belly,
ayahs.arabic: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ

ayahs.text: like the boiling of burning despair.
ayahs.arabic: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

ayahs.text: [And the word will be spoken:] “Seize him, [O you forces of hell,] and drag him into the midst of the blazing fire:
ayahs.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

ayahs.text: then pour over his head the anguish of burning despair!
ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ

ayahs.text: Taste it - thou who [on earth] hast considered thyself so mighty, so noble!
ayahs.arabic: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ

ayahs.text: This is the very thing which you [deniers of the truth] were wont to call in question!”
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ

ayahs.text: [As against this -] verily, the God-conscious will find themselves in a state secure,
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍۢ

ayahs.text: amid gardens and springs,
ayahs.arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ

ayahs.text: wearing [garments] of silk and brocade, facing one another [in love].
ayahs.arabic: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍۢ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

ayahs.text: Thus shall it be. And We shall pair them with companions pure, most beautiful of eye.
ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ

ayahs.text: In that [paradise] they shall [rightfully] claim all the fruits [of their past deeds], resting in security;
ayahs.arabic: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ

ayahs.text: and neither shall they taste death there after having passed through their erstwhile death. Thus will He have preserved them from all suffer­ing through the blazing fire-
ayahs.arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

ayahs.text: an act of thy Sustainer’s favour: and that, that will be the triumph supreme!
ayahs.arabic: فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ

ayahs.text: THUS, THEN, [O Prophet,] have We made this [divine writ] easy to understand, in thine own [human] tongue, so that men might take it to heart.
ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ

ayahs.text: So wait thou [for what the future will bring]: behold, they, too, are waiting.
ayahs.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
